description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'AccessFlowStateMachineDao' that manages database operations related to workflow state machine entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for querying, saving, deleting, and updating workflow states, roles, and actions, specifically for access flow control within the HRM system.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling CRUD operations and queries related to WorkflowStateMachine entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves allowed actions for a given workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Fetches workflow items based on workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Returns the next workflow state based on current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves workflow states on which certain actions are permissible for a role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a WorkflowStateMachine entity to the database.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of WorkflowStateMachine entities.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on parameters.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records associated with a specific user role, optionally filtered by workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates the role name in WorkflowStateMachine records when a role is renamed.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Fetches all allowed recruitment application states for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow records for a specific workflow, optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed in a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkflowStateMachine entity by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Fetches a WorkflowStateMachine entity based on workflow, state, action, and role.
